kept.why: The newest one is kept: it may be the only way back.

kept.note: Made by hand or by another tool, so ByteSweep only explains it. Btrfs can't size one without quotas. If nobody needs it, the command removes it (as root); check it is the snapshot first: the path is from the top of the filesystem.

kept.description: Snapshot of bsvg/data, 0% of its area used
kept.note: LVM sets this area aside for it, and every write to data is slower while it exists. ByteSweep only explains it: a backup run may still read it. When nothing does, the command removes it (as root).
